meta.title: Cloud sync
meta.description: Mirror the plugin roster and whitelisted plugin settings through a private GitHub repo or a synced folder.
meta.detail:
## Cloud sync

Keeps the profile plugin roster and whitelisted plugin settings in a private repository or a folder your cloud drive already syncs, then aligns another machine in one click.

- Data only: plugin names, versions, enabled state, and explicitly whitelisted settings. Credentials, sign-in state, and session logs never leave the machine.
- Two transports: a private GitHub repository (fine-grained token, Contents read/write) or a local/synced folder such as OneDrive.
- Every pull renders a diff first; installing or overwriting always needs your explicit selection, and auto sync is off by default.
- Installs go through the DSH `pluginManager` service — the same path as the plugin manager UI.
